title: No physicists on NASA's follow-up UAP study

tellings.quote:
my wife and I
were approached to help with the UAP.
NASA was doing their own UAP thing

plain: When NASA, the US space agency, ran its own study of UAP, the government's term for UFOs, in 2023 and 2024, there were no physicists on the follow-up team, says Charles Buhler, a NASA engineer. He speaks as someone who was there: "my wife and I were approached to help with the UAP. NASA was doing their own UAP thing." His point is that a study of strange flying objects left out the very scientists best placed to explain how they might move.
